race.name: Kostarian Macaque
entries: Kostarian Macaques are small primates native to the rainforests of Kostaria.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Dexterity score increases by 2, and your Constitution score increases by 1.

entries.name: Climber
entries: You have a Climb Speed equal to your Speed.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You have {@sense Darkvision} with a range of 60 feet.

entries.name: Fury of the Small
entries: When you damage a creature with an attack or a spell and the creature's size is larger than yours, you can cause the attack or spell to deal extra damage to the creature. The extra damage equals your level. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a Short or Long Rest.

entries.name: Nimble Escape
entries: You can take the {@action Disengage|XPHB} or {@action Hide|XPHB} action as a Bonus Action on each of your turns.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can understand Common and Monkey.
